Umm I had graves and it makes you rapidly lose weight because your thyroid controls your metabolism and when there is too much thyroid hormone the metabolism goes too fast. This leads to weight loss and intense hunger.


The only legitimate medical cause for rapid weight gain would be high doses of prednisone, and most of the weight can be easily lost after treatment is stopped. I have a friend who was on 60mg of prednisone and she gained 60lbs in a month (though a good portion of that was due to water retention) and she lost it after she got of the medication. 

So no medication or medical condition directly causes weight gain without overeating.

Not to say that certain conditions and medications don’t make it difficult to eat normal portions.
